## ☀️🏃 BH4H's Sun Run

Bring Happiness for Hospice (BH4H) is a student organization raising funds and awareness to support hospice patients and their families. They're hosting their first walk-or-run 5K. 100% of proceeds go toward fulfilling the wishes of hospice patients and supporting families facing end-of-life care.

- Sunday October 4 at 9:00 AM;
- Duke University East Campus Loop.
